correctness.rationale: PASS: For any target metric, the pullback pseudometric on Petersen vertices can be dihedrally averaged without changing pair-sum S or weighted edge-sum D_t. Seven pair orbits with weights 5,5,10,5,10,5,5 and two realizable graph-route certificates imply S<=25(x+y+z) and S<=20(x+y)+45z for averaged rim lengths x,y and spoke z. The convex combination coefficient (9-4t)/(4+t) on 1<=t<=9/4 gives S<=125(x+y+t z)/(4+t); for outer regimes direct coefficient comparisons give S/D_t<=5/t and <=4. With total conductance 5(2+t), Gamma=(2+t) S/(10D_t). Three actual target metrics respectively attain each bound: two-point rim collapse, intrinsic edge-length metric (2,2,1), and five-cycle spoke collapse. Independent exact rational shortest-path and triangle-inequality calculations for t=1/11,1/2,1,10/9,3/2,2,9/4,5/2,7 corroborated equality. The universal metric upper proof uses all seven pair orbits, not sampling. Equality within 1<t<9/4 forces averaged x=y=2z.
